_meta._note: On-device privacy values of the client and its tools (what may leave the device and in what shape). Server-side PDPA values (positionLogTtl_s, minAge_yr) live only in config/balance/privacy.json (P1-H03, systems-designer); do not duplicate them here. Loaders must namespace by path (app.privacy vs balance.privacy). Keys starting with '_' are metadata: code skips them. null = not set yet: code must fail loudly, never guess.

onDeviceSamples._note: Hard cap on raw position samples (lat, lng, accuracy, time) that the session state may hold, in memory or in kw.p2.session. A sample older than now_ms - maxAge_s is purged on every step and on load; at most maxCount samples exist at once. Config lint (P2-F04-T24) checks: maxAge_s <= balance.privacy.positionLogTtl_s; maxAge_s <= balance.dungeons.movementGate.window_s (D-088); maxAge_s >= balance.dungeons.movementGate.maxSamplePairGap_s; maxCount >= 2 x (1 + balance.dungeons.movementGate.outlierReanchorSamples) + 2. When a run ends every sample-bearing field is removed before the next persist, so storage never holds coordinates of a finished run

localData._note: Clearing removes every key with the prefix (session, telemetry, consent, settings) and reloads into onboarding. Telemetry writes never evict the session; a session write that hits the quota first trims then clears the telemetry ring buffer, and only then keeps the session in memory with a visible storage-degraded flag. Nothing here leaves the device

externalNavigation._source: D-089 / A-P2-PLAN-01-3 conditions 3 and 5; spec F04 R37; docs/tech/F04-dungeon-presence.md 14
externalNavigation._note: Descriptive guard rails for the navigation button and its tests: the URL carries only the dungeon's public destination point and walking mode, never the player's position, origin, or any game query parameter; opened from an <a> tapped by the player with rel=noopener noreferrer. The link is a top-level navigation chosen by the player, not a request of the app, so it is outside the allowed-origin list of config/app/client.json
